subject: Private Offer renewal + EU VAT / capacity increase (Verdant Health)
messages:
From: Clara Diaz <clara@verdanthealth.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot@redwood.com>
Cc: James O'Leary <james.oleary@verdanthealth.com>, procurement@verdanthealth.com
Date: 2026-10-28T09:12:00Z
Subject: Renewal and capacity uplift — private offer + EU VAT questions

Hi Elliot,

We're kicking off Verdant's renewal for Q4. A few things we need to lock down: 1) we want to move to a 12‑month private offer on the AWS Marketplace (our procurement team requires marketplace billing), 2) increase committed capacity from 8 to 20 GPU units (steady state average), and 3) confirm EU VAT handling and whether invoices can originate from the Marketplace in Ireland.

Can you share the latest private offer draft and the timeline for legal/finance signoff? Ideally we'd get a PO signed by the week of Nov 8 so we don't lose pricing. Attaching Verdant's procurement checklist in a follow-up (procurement@verdanthealth will coordinate).

Thanks,
Clara
Clara Diaz
Director, Cloud Procurement
Verdant Health

Attachment: verdant_procurement_checklist.pdf (PDF stub)

From: Elliot Price <elliot@redwood.com>
To: Clara Diaz <clara@verdanthealth.com>
Cc: James O'Leary <james.oleary@verdanthealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T14:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal and capacity uplift — private offer + EU VAT questions

Hi Clara — thanks for the clear ask. 

Short answers: we can do a 12‑month AWS Marketplace private offer billed via the Marketplace (invoices can originate from the EU entity), and we can support the capacity uplift to 20 GPUs via a staged activation (30% up front, remainder within 45 days) to meet your consumption patterns.

Next steps I propose:
- Marissa will assemble the Marketplace private offer (pricing sheet + PO-ready DocuSign)
- Marcus will confirm invoice issuing entity and VAT handling with finance/legal
- Naomi will run a quick legal pass on the private offer amendments (IP/data clauses + billing flow)

Marissa/Marcus/Naomi — can you take ownership of the bullets above? If you want, I'll open a HubSpot task and post the drive folder. Clara — I'll aim to get a draft private offer and a Docusign link over to you by Nov 4.

Elliot
Elliot Price
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: none

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T10:18:00Z
Subject: RE: Private offer for Verdant — draft and checklist (internal)

Folks — looping in Laura for billing runbook finalization. I've attached an initial private offer (Verdant_Private_Offer_v1.pdf) and a renewal_summary.xlsx with proposed staged activation schedule and pricing. Key open items:

1) VAT & invoice entity: Marcus, confirm if we can issue Marketplace invoice via Redwood EU entity (Ireland) and whether procurement needs any tax annex.
2) Legal redlines: Naomi, I highlighted a couple of clauses around data retention & audit logs that Verdant flagged — would like a 24‑48h turnaround if possible.
3) Payment terms: Procurement asked for Net 45. We typically do Net 30 on marketplace PO — Laura, can we support Net 45 for this renewal if contract value > $250k?

Attachment: Verdant_Private_Offer_v1.pdf (PDF stub)
Attachment: renewal_summary.xlsx (XLSX stub)

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Marketplace & Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Elliot Price <elliot@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T15:44:00Z
Subject: RE: Private offer for Verdant — VAT and billing

Quick update: finance confirms we can route Marketplace invoices through our Irish subsidiary for AWS Marketplace transactions. We'll provide an invoice template and VAT annex for Verdant's procurement team. Regarding Net 45 — we can approve Net 45 for this renewal provided we attach a short credit memo and escalate to billing ops (Laura) for the staggered invoice schedule. I'll draft the VAT annex and send to Naomi for signoff by EOD Nov 4.

I'll also note: to support the staged activation (30/70) the marketplace PO will need line items for the initial capacity and a second line for the remaining commitment; the Marketplace private offer must reflect that.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Billing
Redwood Inference

From: Elliot Price <elliot@redwood.com>
To: Clara Diaz <clara@verdanthealth.com>
Cc: James O'Leary <james.oleary@verdanthealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T09:08:00Z
Subject: Private offer draft + DocuSign link and PO guidance

Hi Clara — attaching the private offer draft and a short renewal summary with staged activation language. Per Marcus, invoices can originate from our Irish entity and we will include a VAT annex. We are prepared to accept Net 45 for this one-off renewal (finance approved with billing ops conditions).

DocuSign (private offer v1): https://www.docusign.com/rec/ds-ver-2026-119
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/7896123/deal/VER-2026-119
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_verdant-renewal

Attachments: Verdant_Private_Offer_v1.pdf; renewal_summary.xlsx

Next steps:
- Verdant to return a PO referencing the Marketplace private offer line items (initial 30% + follow-up 70%)
- We will route DocuSign for signatures once PO is received to maintain procurement audit trail

Appreciate the urgency — we'll prioritize the legal redlines.

Best,
Elliot

From: Clara Diaz <clara@verdanthealth.com>

Elliot — thanks. See attached official PO (signed_po_verdant_20261109.pdf). The PO references the private offer (line 1: initial activation 6 GPU units; line 2: committed 14 GPU units for remainder). Procurement confirms Net 45 is acceptable.

Two quick asks before DocuSign: 1) can you send the VAT annex to procurement@verdanthealth.com so our tax team can confirm? 2) we need the final Marketplace invoice example with Irish VAT number shown for our AP system mapping.

Attaching: signed_po_verdant_20261109.pdf (PDF stub)

Clara
